# Opsburg

> Keep your cloud up and running. Play it like a city. Opsburg builds and ships your apps and AI agents, from the repository to your Kubernetes, and turns running them into a game: every service is a building, every deploy an airship, every incident a storm.

## The platform

- Build: apps and AI agents from templates, with repositories on GitHub, GitLab or Azure DevOps and CI included
- Ship: a tag builds and registers the version; one click deploys it through GitOps and Argo CD, with rollback
- Run: live state, logs and incidents; AI agents read logs and propose fixes, waiting for approval before touching production
- Your rules: single sign-on, roles, your AI models, self-hosted, MCP server for AI clients

## The game

- Uptime streaks, missions for real chores, storm drills, a city that grows with your platform

## The city

- Clocktower: control plane
- Boiler House: compute node
- Factory: service
- Vault: database
- Telegraph: message queue and logs
- Observatory: monitoring
- Airship: deploy
- Automaton: AI agent
- Storm: incident; pressure: load; coal: cost

Status: in development, not playable yet.
